updates.title: CVE-2026-62916: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network, potentially compromising identity and access controls. This is a critical issue that requires immediate patching to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in your tenant.

updates.title: CVE-2026-83941: Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A missing authorization flaw in Entra ID permits authorized attackers to escalate their privileges over the network. This vulnerability could allow a compromised or malicious admin account to gain unauthorized elevated access.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69524: Windows Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution
updates.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network without authentication. This critical flaw in on-premises AD infrastructure requires immediate patching to prevent complete compromise of directory services.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69359: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege
updates.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Domain Services permits authorized attackers to escalate privileges locally on affected systems. Admins must apply patches promptly to secure on-premises AD infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Expansion to Copilot + PC Devices for Recall Snapshots
updates.summary: Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention is extending coverage to Copilot + PCs to protect sensitive data captured by Windows Recall snapshots through custom policies. Admins can now author DLP policies specifically for Copilot + PC devices managed by Intune to prevent unauthorized capture of restricted sensitivity labels and sensitive information types.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management—Secure Workflow to Bypass Legal Holds and Retention Policies
updates.summary: A new Priority Cleanup workflow enables admins to create recurring exceptions for deleting items under retention policies or legal holds on Exchange, with mandatory multi-approver review and complete audit logging. This feature introduces a dedicated security role to control who can initiate these bypass exceptions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access for Network-Layer File Filtering
updates.summary: Purview Data Loss Prevention policies can now filter sensitive files at the network layer by integrating with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access, intercepting and inspecting file transfers to untrusted cloud apps, SaaS platforms, and AI services. This extends DLP enforcement beyond Microsoft 365 to browsers, APIs, and add-ins with centralized alerting and incident management.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Expansion to Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: DLP protection now extends to Microsoft Cowork, allowing admins to enforce a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork to prevent sensitive AI interactions, block prompts containing sensitive information types, and restrict Bing web search access for sensitive content. This unifies data protection across generative AI workloads.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management—Retention Based on Last Accessed for OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Retention labels and policies can now be applied to OneDrive and SharePoint files based on their last-access date, enabling more granular lifecycle management and automated removal of stale content. This helps organizations reduce storage costs and improve compliance by targeting truly dormant data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management—Automated Deletion of Inactive OneDrives and Mailboxes for Departing Employees
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now automatically delete both content and containers for departed users at scale, streamlining offboarding and reducing manual compliance effort. This helps organizations meet regulatory requirements by ensuring no sensitive data remains accessible after employee departure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management—Retention Policies for Microsoft Planner
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now create retention policies for Microsoft Planner content associated with Microsoft 365 Groups, extending data lifecycle management beyond traditional SharePoint and Exchange workloads. This brings task management data under centralized compliance governance.

updates.title: Data Loss Prevention—DLP Policy Change Insights with Security Copilot
updates.summary: Copilot for Security can now summarize and analyze DLP policies, providing admins with insights on policy coverage across locations, classifiers, and notifications through natural language prompts. This enables DLP admins to regularly review and adjust their data security posture more efficiently.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management—Sensitive Data Insights and Policy Recommendations
updates.summary: Purview now provides admins with insights on sensitive data across OneDrive and SharePoint, along with AI-driven recommendations for applying retention policies to improve data security and compliance posture. This helps identify and govern high-risk unmanaged sensitive data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP—Archive File Classification Behavior Change
updates.summary: Archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints is being updated to align with cloud workload handling, reducing noise in event reporting and improving performance when processing archive files. This change enhances consistency across Purview's DLP enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps (Box, Google Workspace)
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace by leveraging existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365. This extends DLP governance to hybrid SaaS environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Auto-Labeling—Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now run in simulation mode before enforcement, allowing admins to preview which items would be labeled and review match results and source distribution without making changes. This reduces the risk of incorrect label application and helps validate policy logic before rollout.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now protect sensitive data in non-Microsoft connected applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and standard classification engines. This allows consistent sensitivity labeling across hybrid cloud environments.
